name: u26-undo-as-of
about: Undo 3 changes back and read as of 300 changes back on frequently edited records. Edits: agent cards, the founder's most edited kind (418 cards, 44.9 versions each in 3 days, max 4,220 [L o03 record_log]); 107 edits/day = founder 5,943/day x K over 8 cards (= 418 x K), 840 B [S o03]. Undo/as-of: 5/day each (plan A-TYP). After ~23 days a card has 300 versions, so the deep read starts finding history beyond any hot window. Sources: [A] 04-every-table-challenged.md; [P] clone queries on o08/o21/o27/o04/o07/o09 (profile-overhead lane, 2026-10-27); [L] clone queries o03 record_log 2026-10-20..22 PDT, o04 namespace_names, o21 account_control_permits operations (4 load days 2026-10-15..23); [S] --seed-from profile: founder o03 2,398,695 current records / 178 kinds, second account o26 24,263 records. Typical sizes come from the second account [S o26] where the kind exists there, else the founder [S o03].
